params.headline: Branded sell sheets for retail and wholesale channels.
params.subhead: Professional product sell sheets that you can hand to retailers, distributors, and healthcare professionals. Branded with your logo, formatted to your spec.

params.content:
The selling tool brands use to close retail and wholesale deals.

When you walk into a retailer, present at a trade show, or pitch a healthcare professional, you need a one-page document that summarizes your product line, key ingredients, dosing, claims, and how to order. A branded sell sheet does that.

We provide pre-built sell sheet templates that you can customize with your brand identity, or work with our design team for fully custom sell sheets matched to your overall brand system.

cards.content: Pre-built one-page sell sheet templates customized with your branding. Fast turnaround, included with private label engagement.
cards.title: Template-based sell sheets

cards.content: Custom sell sheets designed by our team to match your overall brand identity. Premium positioning, slower turnaround.
cards.title: Fully custom design

cards.content: Print-ready PDFs, web-friendly PDFs, and editable source files. Use them across digital and print channels.
cards.title: Multi-format delivery

params.content: Schedule a consultation. We will walk through your audience, the right formulations for them, branding options, and the timeline.
params.headline: Ready to launch your private label supplement line?

items.answer: Product image, key claims, ingredient highlights, suggested retail pricing (MSRP), wholesale pricing, MOQ for retailers, and shelf-ready packaging info. Sell sheets are designed for buyers at retail accounts to evaluate whether to bring your product onto their shelves.
items.question: What goes on a supplement sell sheet?

items.answer: Template-based sell sheets are included with most private label engagements. Fully custom sell sheets (matching your premium brand identity, multi-page collateral, trade show booth materials) are separately scoped based on your needs.
items.question: Are sell sheets included or separately priced?

items.answer: Yes. You can adapt sell sheets per account (different pricing, different positioning) once you have the template established. We provide editable source files for ongoing self-service updates, or we can produce per-account variants for major retailers.
items.question: Can sell sheets be customized per retail account?

items.answer: Print-ready PDFs (high resolution for tradeshow printing) and lighter web PDFs for email pitches. You can use them digitally or print as needed. Standard one-page sell sheets work for most situations; some categories warrant longer collateral pieces.
items.question: What format do sell sheets come in?

items.answer: Depends on your line. Tightly themed lines (a single brand with 3-5 connected SKUs) usually benefit from a combined sell sheet showing the system. Broader catalogs work better as per-SKU sheets so retailers can evaluate one product at a time. We help you think through this based on your target accounts.
items.question: Should I have a different sell sheet for each SKU or one combined?
